item.title: Show HN: Collections, a Chrome side panel to save links, text and images
item.summary: Collections, a Chrome side panel for keeping what you find while researching: drag a link, a selected passage or an image from the page into a named collection, save the current tab with one click, copy the collection out as Markdown. Local-first (chrome.storage), no account; optional Google sync is in the works. Built because Edge removed its Collections feature in June and Pocket shut down last year.
